faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about Bailo.
faq.contact.title: Didn't find your answer?
faq.contact.subtitle: Our support team is available to help you.
faq.a1: Bailo is a Belgian platform that allows landlords and tenants to rate each other. The goal is to create a trust history to secure rentals.
faq.a2: Profile creation and viewing basic reviews are free. Premium features may be offered.
faq.a3: Yes, Bailo covers all of Belgium: Wallonia, Flanders and Brussels.
faq.q4: Can I see a landlord's reviews before renting?
faq.a4: Yes, that's the principle of Bailo. You can view reviews left by former tenants.
faq.q5: How can I rate my landlord?
faq.a5: After your rental period, you can leave a review on several criteria: property condition, responsiveness, commitment compliance, communication.
faq.q6: What if I receive an unjustified bad review?
faq.a6: You have the right to respond. You can contest a review if it is false or defamatory.
faq.a7: Yes, Bailo complies with GDPR. Your data is never shared without your consent.
faq.q8: How can I verify a potential tenant?
faq.a8: Search for the candidate's profile on Bailo to see their rental history and reviews from former landlords.
faq.q9: Can I refuse a tenant because of a bad rating?
faq.a9: Bailo provides information, but the decision is yours. We encourage you to consider the entire profile and dialogue with the candidate.
faq.q10: How to rate a tenant after they leave?
faq.a10: Log into your account and leave a review on objective criteria: rent payment, property maintenance, neighborhood respect, communication.
faq.a11: No, Bailo is a complementary tool. Rental guarantees and insurance are still recommended.
faq.a12: Only verified users can leave reviews. We verify that the rental relationship actually existed.
faq.q13: What to do in case of abuse?
faq.a13: Report the abusive review. Our moderation team examines each report.
faq.a14: No. Bailo is a balanced reputation system, not a blacklist. Both parties are rated, and everyone can improve their score over time.

legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Purpose, Scope and Acceptance
legal.terms.s1.content:
These Terms of Service (hereinafter "Terms") govern access to and use of the Bailo platform, published by **DSquare Development SRL** (BCE 0795.655.168), a private limited company under Belgian law, with its registered office at Rue du Bois Garguenne 108, 4400 Flémalle, Belgium.

By accessing bailo.be and creating an account, you unreservedly accept these Terms in their entirety. If you do not accept these Terms, you may not use the platform.

These Terms apply to all use of the platform, whether free or paid, and to all Users, whether Landlords, Tenants or both. They take precedence over any other document, except for specific conditions expressly accepted in writing by DSquare Development SRL.
legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Definitions
legal.terms.s2.content:
For the purposes of these Terms, the following terms mean:

- **"Platform"**: the website bailo.be and all associated services published by DSquare Development SRL under the Bailo brand.
- **"User"**: any adult natural person who has created an account on the Platform.
- **"Landlord"**: a User who has activated the landlord role and manages properties through the Platform.
- **"Tenant"**: a User who has activated the tenant role.
- **"Rental Relationship"**: the link between a Landlord and one or more Tenants, formalised on the Platform for a given property and period.
- **"Review"**: a rating left by a User at the end of a Rental Relationship, covering the property, the Landlord or the Tenant(s).
- **"Boost"**: an optional paid service allowing a property to be featured in Platform search results for one calendar month.
- **"Subscription"**: a paid access contract to the Platform's premium features, taken out by the Landlord.
legal.terms.s3.title: 3. Registration and User Account
legal.terms.s3.content:
### 3.1 Registration Requirements

Registration is reserved for natural persons aged 18 or over. By registering, you declare that you:
- Are of legal age and have full legal capacity to enter into contracts;
- Provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information;
- Have not previously had a Bailo account suspended or deleted.

Each User may only hold one active account. Creating multiple accounts is prohibited and may result in deletion of all accounts concerned.

### 3.2 Identity Verification (KYC)

To ensure the reliability of the Platform, DSquare Development SRL offers identity verification (Know Your Customer, "KYC") via:
- **Veriff**: available for all users.

This verification is optional but strongly recommended. It grants access to the "Verified Profile" badge, publicly visible and attesting to the authenticity of the User's identity.

### 3.3 Account Security

The User is solely responsible for the confidentiality of their login credentials and for any activity carried out from their account. In the event of suspected compromise, they must immediately notify DSquare Development SRL at [contact@bailo.be](mailto:contact@bailo.be).
legal.terms.s4.title: 4. Services Provided
legal.terms.s5.title: 5. User Obligations
legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Reviews: Rules, Moderation and Remedies
legal.terms.s6.content:
### 6.1 Publication Requirements

A Review may only be submitted at the end of a Rental Relationship officially recorded on the Platform. Every Review must be:
- Objective, factual and honest;
- Written with respect for the person being reviewed;
- Free from any defamatory, discriminatory or hateful content;
- Relating solely to the Rental Relationship in question.

### 6.2 Delayed Disclosure (double-blind)

Reviews remain confidential until both parties have submitted their respective Review, or upon expiry of **15 calendar days** from the closure of the Rental Relationship. This mechanism guarantees the independence and authenticity of reviews.

### 6.3 Right of Reply

Any User who is the subject of a Review has a **right of public reply**, exercisable within 30 days of the Review's publication. This reply must comply with the same rules as the original Review.

### 6.4 Moderation and Reporting

DSquare Development SRL moderates content published on the Platform. Any User may report a Review they consider contrary to these Terms. DSquare Development SRL reserves the right to remove any manifestly unlawful or defamatory Review after examination.
legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Subscriptions and Pricing
legal.terms.s7.content:
### 7.1 Free Launch Offer

As a promotional offer, each Landlord receives **one (1) free property for twelve (12) months** from the date their first property is added. The **first 100 registered users** additionally receive **3 free Property Boosts** (commercial value: €60 incl. VAT). This offer is available while places last.

### 7.2 Current Pricing

- **Monthly subscription:** €5 incl. VAT per property per month, automatically renewed on the 1st of each month. The first invoice is calculated on a **pro rata temporis** basis until the 1st of the following month.
- **Annual subscription:** €50 incl. VAT per property per year (2 months free). Switching from monthly to annual takes effect the following month; the remaining monthly balance is deducted.
- **Property Boost:** €20 incl. VAT per property per month, not automatically renewed and **non-refundable** once activated.

All prices are quoted in euros inclusive of all taxes (incl. VAT). DSquare Development SRL reserves the right to change its prices with at least 30 days' notice by email.
legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Payment and Invoicing
legal.terms.s8.content:
### 8.1 Payment Provider

Payments are processed by **Mollie B.V.**, a payment service provider licensed and supervised by the Dutch Central Bank (DNB). DSquare Development SRL does not store your bank or card details at any time.

### 8.2 Accepted Payment Methods

- Credit/debit card (Visa, Mastercard)
- PayPal
- Bancontact
- iDEAL

All transactions are secured by SSL/TLS encryption.

### 8.3 Invoicing

An electronic invoice is automatically generated and available in the User's personal space after each payment. In the event of a failed payment, DSquare Development SRL makes up to 3 attempts within 7 days before suspending access to paid features.
legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Right of Withdrawal
legal.terms.s9.content:
In accordance with **Articles VI.47 et seq. of the Belgian Code of Economic Law** and Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights, any consumer User who has taken out a paid Subscription has a **14-calendar-day right of withdrawal** from the date of subscription, without having to justify their decision or pay any penalty.

### How to Exercise This Right

Notify your withdrawal decision to DSquare Development SRL by email at [contact@bailo.be](mailto:contact@bailo.be), indicating your withdrawal request and your Subscription reference. You may use the following template:

*"I hereby notify you of my withdrawal from the contract for the Bailo Subscription taken out on [date]. Name: [name]. Email: [email]."*

### Exception — Fully Executed Digital Services

In accordance with **Article VI.53, 13° of the Belgian Code of Economic Law**, the right of withdrawal **does not apply** to digital services fully performed before the expiry of the withdrawal period, where the User has expressly consented to performance beginning and acknowledged losing their right of withdrawal. The **Property Boost** service is notably subject to this exception once activated.
legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Refunds and Termination
legal.terms.s10.content:
### 10.1 Refund Following Withdrawal

Upon valid exercise of the right of withdrawal, DSquare Development SRL processes a full refund within **14 calendar days** of notification, using the same payment method as the original transaction.

### 10.2 Termination by the User

The User may cancel their Subscription at any time from their personal space. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. No pro rata refund is granted for the remaining period, except upon valid exercise of the right of withdrawal.

Data is retained for 30 days after cancellation before permanent deletion, unless an earlier express request is made by the User.

### 10.3 Termination by DSquare Development SRL

DSquare Development SRL may suspend or terminate an account in the event of serious breach of these Terms, fraudulent behaviour or persistent non-payment. Prior notification by email is sent to the User, except in cases of manifestly unlawful behaviour requiring immediate action.

legal.terms.s14.title: 14. Personal Data Protection
legal.terms.s14.content:
DSquare Development SRL processes Users' personal data in accordance with **Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)** and the **Belgian law of 30 July 2018** on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.

The data collected, the purposes of processing, the rights of data subjects (access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability, restriction) and the ways of exercising those rights are detailed in our **[Privacy Policy](/privacy)**.

legal.terms.s15.title: 15. Amendments — Disputes — Governing Law
legal.terms.s15.content:
### 15.1 Amendments to the Terms

DSquare Development SRL may amend these Terms at any time. In the event of a material change, Users will be notified by email and/or Platform notification with at least **30 days' notice**. Continued use of the Platform after the new Terms take effect constitutes acceptance of those Terms.

### 15.2 Amicable Resolution

In the event of a dispute, the parties undertake to seek an amicable solution first. Any complaint should be sent to [contact@bailo.be](mailto:contact@bailo.be). DSquare Development SRL undertakes to respond within **15 working days**.

### 15.3 Mediation and Online Dispute Resolution

Belgian consumers may also contact the **Consumer Mediation Service**: [mediationconsommateur.be](https://www.mediationconsommateur.be)

### 15.4 Governing Law and Jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by **Belgian law**. Failing amicable resolution, any dispute shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the **Enterprise Court of Liège (Liège division)**. Consumers may also bring proceedings before the court of their place of domicile, in accordance with the Belgian Code of Economic Law.

about.title: About Bailo
about.subtitle: We are revolutionizing trust in rental real estate by creating a transparent and secure ecosystem for landlords and tenants.
about.mission.title: Our mission
about.mission.content: At Bailo, we believe that trust is the foundation of any successful rental relationship. Our platform enables landlords and tenants to build a verifiable reputation based on authentic reviews and certified profiles. We want to eliminate the uncertainty and stress associated with property rentals.
about.values.title: Our values
about.values.trust.title: Trust
about.values.trust.desc: We place trust at the heart of our platform with KYC verifications and authenticated reviews.
about.values.transparency.title: Transparency
about.values.transparency.desc: Complete access to rental histories and reviews for informed decisions.
about.values.innovation.title: Innovation
about.values.innovation.desc: We use the latest technologies to simplify and secure the rental experience.
about.values.community.title: Community
about.values.community.desc: We are building a community of responsible and committed landlords and tenants.
about.story.title: Our story
about.story.content: Bailo was born from a simple observation: finding a trustworthy tenant or a reliable landlord shouldn't be an obstacle course. Founded by a team passionate about real estate and technology, our platform meets the real needs of the French rental market by bringing transparency and peace of mind to all stakeholders.
howItWorks.hero.title: Discover how Bailo works
howItWorks.hero.subtitle: An intuitive platform that revolutionizes rental relationships in 6 simple steps. Build your reputation and rent with confidence.
howItWorks.step1.title: Registration and identity verification
howItWorks.step1.desc: Create your account and verify your identity via Veriff to guarantee a 100% verified profile. This essential step ensures that all Bailo users are real people, creating a trusted environment.
howItWorks.step1.feature3: Verified profile badge visible to all
howItWorks.step2.title: Property management (Landlords)
howItWorks.step2.desc: As a landlord, easily add your properties to the platform. View your entire real estate portfolio, track rented and available properties, all from a centralized dashboard.
howItWorks.step2.feature1: Add properties in a few clicks
howItWorks.step3.title: View profiles and reviews
howItWorks.step3.desc: Before committing, view profiles of landlords, tenants and properties. Access reviews left by former rental partners to make informed decisions.
howItWorks.step4.title: Creating a rental relationship
howItWorks.step4.desc: The landlord initiates the rental relationship by selecting a tenant already registered on Bailo or by inviting them to join the platform. This step formalizes the link between the parties.
howItWorks.step4.feature2: Or invite them by email to join Bailo
howItWorks.step5.title: Centralized documents
howItWorks.step5.desc: All your important documents in one place! View and manage the lease, entry and exit inventories, and all other rental-related documents directly in the rental relationship space.
howItWorks.step6.title: Mutual reviews at closure
howItWorks.step6.desc: At the end of the rental, each party is invited to review the other. Reviews remain confidential until both parties have submitted their review, or after 15 days, ensuring sincere and balanced feedback.
howItWorks.step6.feature2: The tenant(s) review(s) the landlord and property
howItWorks.step6.feature3: Reviews revealed after both parties submit or after 15 days
howItWorks.reputation.title: Build your rental reputation
howItWorks.reputation.desc: Every successful rental strengthens your reputation. Bailo creates a reliable rental history that follows and values you. Landlords and tenants build together an ecosystem of mutual trust.
howItWorks.reputation.benefits.title: Benefits of a good reputation
howItWorks.reputation.benefits.item1: More easily find housing or quality tenants
howItWorks.reputation.benefits.item2: Negotiate from a position of trust
howItWorks.reputation.benefits.item3: Benefit from transparency in your rental relationships
howItWorks.reputation.benefits.item4: Contribute to a healthier rental market

tutorials.profile.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · Click your avatar in the top right · Select "Profile" from the dropdown menu
tutorials.profile.title: Fill in your profile
tutorials.profile.subtitle: Your Bailo profile is your calling card. Complete it to inspire trust.
tutorials.profile.step1.title: Basic information
tutorials.profile.step1.desc: Start by filling in your personal information. This data identifies your account and ensures trust between all parties.
tutorials.profile.step1.fields: First name · Last name · Phone number · Date of birth · Profile photo
tutorials.profile.step1.tip: Tip: use your real name and a recent photo. Complete profiles inspire more trust from other users.
tutorials.profile.step2.title: Choose your role
tutorials.profile.step2.desc: Indicate whether you are a tenant, a landlord, or both. This choice determines the features and profile sections available to you. You can activate both roles simultaneously.
tutorials.profile.step2.fields: Tenant role (toggle) · Landlord role (toggle) · Both roles can be active at the same time
tutorials.profile.step2.tip: Tip: only activate the roles you actually use. This simplifies your experience and your public profile.
tutorials.profile.step3.title: Identity verification (KYC)
tutorials.profile.step3.desc: To guarantee trust on the platform, Bailo offers identity verification. Once verified, a badge appears on your public profile, strengthening your credibility.
tutorials.profile.step3.fields: Verification via Veriff · Verified badge displayed on profile
tutorials.profile.step3.tip: Identity verification is strongly recommended. Verified profiles receive significantly more positive responses.
tutorials.ownerProfile.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · Click your avatar in the top right and select "Profile" · Scroll down to the role selection and enable the "Owner" role · The "Owner" entry then becomes clickable in the avatar menu and in the side menu of the profile page
tutorials.ownerProfile.title: Landlord profile
tutorials.ownerProfile.subtitle: Complete your landlord profile to build trust with potential tenants.
tutorials.ownerProfile.step1.title: Landlord information
tutorials.ownerProfile.step1.desc: Enter the information specific to your landlord activity. This information allows tenants to get to know you better before entering into a relationship.
tutorials.ownerProfile.step1.fields: Biography · Professional situation · IBAN (for refunds) · Language(s) spoken
tutorials.ownerProfile.step1.tip: Tip: write an honest and welcoming biography. Explain your approach as a landlord.
tutorials.ownerProfile.step2.title: Profile visibility
tutorials.ownerProfile.step2.desc: Choose which information is publicly visible on your landlord profile. Sensitive data (IBAN) is never publicly visible.
tutorials.ownerProfile.step2.fields: Phone number visibility · Email visibility · Privacy settings per field
tutorials.ownerProfile.step2.tip: Tip: make your profile as complete and public as possible. Transparency builds trust.
tutorials.tenantProfile.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · Click your avatar in the top right and select "Profile" · Scroll down to the role selection and enable the "Tenant" role · The "Tenant" entry then becomes clickable in the avatar menu and in the side menu of the profile page
tutorials.tenantProfile.title: Tenant profile
tutorials.tenantProfile.subtitle: A complete tenant profile increases your chances of getting your dream rental.
tutorials.tenantProfile.step1.title: Tenant information
tutorials.tenantProfile.step1.desc: Provide the information that will allow landlords to assess your application. A complete profile significantly increases your chances of acceptance.
tutorials.tenantProfile.step1.fields: Biography · Professional situation · Monthly net income · Guarantor · Type of employment contract · Language(s) spoken
tutorials.tenantProfile.step1.tip: Tip: be transparent about your situation. Landlords appreciate honest candidates.
tutorials.tenantProfile.step2.title: Profile visibility
tutorials.tenantProfile.step2.desc: Control which information is visible on your public tenant profile. Sensitive financial information is only shared with relevant landlords.
tutorials.tenantProfile.step2.fields: Phone number visibility · Email visibility · Income visibility · Privacy settings
tutorials.tenantProfile.step2.tip: Tip: a visible and complete profile reassures landlords and speeds up decision-making.
tutorials.createEstate.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · In the top navigation bar, click "Properties" · On the "My properties" page, click the "+ Create property" button in the top right
tutorials.createEstate.title: Create a property
tutorials.createEstate.subtitle: Publish your property in a few steps and start receiving applications.
tutorials.createEstate.step1.title: General information
tutorials.createEstate.step1.desc: Start by filling in the basic information about your property. This data will form the main listing visible to potential tenants.
tutorials.createEstate.step1.fields: Full address · Property type (apartment, house, studio…) · Surface area (m²) · Floor · Property description
tutorials.createEstate.step1.tip: Tip: write a detailed and honest description. Mention the highlights but also any constraints.
tutorials.createEstate.step2.title: Features and amenities
tutorials.createEstate.step2.desc: Specify your property's features by selecting the corresponding cards. This information helps tenants assess whether the property suits their needs.
tutorials.createEstate.step2.fields: Number of bedrooms · Number of bathrooms · Parking · Garden/terrace · Cellar · Elevator · Pets allowed · Furnished/unfurnished · Additional amenities
tutorials.createEstate.step2.tip: Tip: select all applicable features. The more complete your listing, the more qualified candidates you will attract.
tutorials.createEstate.step3.title: Availability and rent
tutorials.createEstate.step3.desc: Define the rental conditions for your property: availability date and rent amount. This information is essential for candidates.
tutorials.createEstate.step3.fields: Availability date · Monthly rent (€) · Bills included or not · Security deposit required
tutorials.createEstate.step3.tip: Tip: set a rent in line with the local market. A consistent price attracts serious candidates more quickly.
tutorials.createApplication.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · In the top navigation bar, click "Rental Applications" · On the "My Rental Applications" page, click the "+ New Application" button in the top right
tutorials.createApplication.title: Create a rental application
tutorials.createApplication.subtitle: Start a rental relationship in a few steps: choose a property, fill in the details, and add tenants.
tutorials.createApplication.step1.title: Select a property
tutorials.createApplication.step1.desc: Browse the list of available properties and select the one for which you want to create an application. Only properties marked as available can be selected.
tutorials.createApplication.step1.fields: Grid of available properties · Property card (address, surface, rent) · Availability indicator
tutorials.createApplication.step1.tip: Tip: check that the property is marked as available before creating the application.
tutorials.createApplication.step2.title: Lease details
tutorials.createApplication.step2.desc: Enter the lease information: planned entry and exit dates, rent amount, and charges. This information will be shared with all parties.
tutorials.createApplication.step2.fields: Entry date · Exit date (optional) · Monthly rent (€) · Charges (€) · Lease type
tutorials.createApplication.step2.tip: Tip: the dates and amounts entered here will serve as reference throughout the tenancy. Be precise.
tutorials.createApplication.step3.title: Add tenants
tutorials.createApplication.step3.desc: Add all tenants who will share the property. You can search for them by name among Bailo users, or invite them by email if they don't have an account yet.
tutorials.createApplication.step3.fields: Search by name or email · Invite by email · "Search" tab / "Invited" tab · Maximum number of tenants
tutorials.createApplication.step3.tip: Tip: invite all co-tenants before submitting. Each tenant will need to accept the application on their side.
tutorials.validateApplication.access.ste: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · In the top navigation bar, click "Rental Applications" · Find the application with the orange "Pending" badge · Click "Manage" at the bottom of its card
tutorials.validateApplication.title: Validate an application
tutorials.validateApplication.subtitle: Review the details of an application and make your decision with full knowledge of the facts.
tutorials.validateApplication.step1.desc: The validation page displays all parties involved: the landlord, the tenants, and the property concerned. Review the profiles to make an informed decision.
tutorials.validateApplication.step1.fiel: Property card (address, features) · Landlord card (profile, reviews) · Tenant card(s) (profile, reviews) · Current application status
tutorials.validateApplication.step1.tip: Tip: review the profiles and reviews of each party before making your decision. This is the main advantage of Bailo.
tutorials.validateApplication.step2.desc: Check the lease conditions: dates, rent, and charges. Make sure everything matches what was agreed.
tutorials.validateApplication.step2.fiel: Entry date · Exit date · Monthly rent · Charges · Lease type
tutorials.validateApplication.step2.tip: Tip: read the conditions carefully before validating. Once approved, the application moves to 'approved' status.
tutorials.validateApplication.step3.titl: Validate, reject or track the request
tutorials.validateApplication.step3.desc: The action card at the bottom of the page depends on your role in the request. If you created it, you track its progress and can delete it as long as it has not been validated. If the request is addressed to you, it is up to you to validate or reject it.
tutorials.validateApplication.step3.fiel: Recipient's view: Validate button and Reject button · Author's view: "Awaiting validation" label and Delete request button · The request is only approved once all parties have validated
tutorials.validateApplication.step3.tip: Important: the screenshot below shows the request author's view, tracking its progress. The Validate and Reject buttons appear for the party the request is addressed to.
tutorials.manageApplication.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · In the top navigation bar, click "Rental Applications" · Find an application with the green "Accepted" badge · Click "Manage" at the bottom of its card
tutorials.manageApplication.title: Manage an application
tutorials.manageApplication.subtitle: View the details of an approved application, manage documents, and track the rental relationship.
tutorials.manageApplication.step1.title: Overview
tutorials.manageApplication.step1.desc: The main page of an approved application displays a summary in stat cards: landlord, tenants, address, and rent. A swiper allows navigation between stats.
tutorials.manageApplication.step1.fields: Landlord card · Tenant(s) card · Address card · Monthly rent card · Review request banner (if available)
tutorials.manageApplication.step1.tip: Tip: if the tenancy is over, a banner invites you to leave a review. Take the opportunity to rate the experience.
tutorials.manageApplication.step2.title: Tab navigation
tutorials.manageApplication.step2.desc: The lower section is organised into tabs. Each tab corresponds to an aspect of the rental relationship: general information, lease, inventory, shared documents, and review.
tutorials.manageApplication.step2.fields: Informations tab (parties and lease details) · Lease tab (contract and closure) · Inventory tab · Documents tab · Review tab, which appears once the tenancy is over
tutorials.manageApplication.step2.tip: Tip: use the Documents tab to centralise all documents related to the tenancy (contract, inventories, rent receipts…).
tutorials.manageApplication.step3.title: Upload a document
tutorials.manageApplication.step3.desc: From the Documents tab, you can upload files directly related to this application. A modal form allows you to choose the file and categorise it.
tutorials.manageApplication.step3.fields: Add document button · File selection · Document category · Upload confirmation · List of already uploaded documents
tutorials.manageApplication.step3.tip: Tip: use clear file names and categorise your documents properly. All application participants have access to them.
tutorials.reviews.access.steps: Log in at dashboard.bailo.be · In the top navigation bar, click "Reviews" · Open the "Rentals to review" tab · Click the rental you want to review to open the review form
tutorials.reviews.title: Reviews
tutorials.reviews.subtitle: Give and view reviews for tenants, landlords, and properties.
tutorials.reviews.step1.title: Create a tenant review
tutorials.reviews.step1.desc: At the end of a tenancy, you can rate each tenant. If multiple tenants were present, a tab per tenant allows you to rate each one individually.
tutorials.reviews.step1.fields: Tenant selection (if multiple) · Overall rating (stars) · Criteria: rent payment · Property maintenance · Neighbourhood respect · Communication · Free comment
tutorials.reviews.step1.tip: Tip: be objective and factual in your reviews. Describe observable behaviours, not value judgements.
tutorials.reviews.step2.title: Create a landlord review
tutorials.reviews.step2.desc: As a tenant, rate the landlord at the end of the tenancy. These reviews help future tenants choose a trustworthy landlord.
tutorials.reviews.step2.fields: Overall rating (stars) · Criteria: property condition · Responsiveness · Honouring commitments · Communication · Free comment
tutorials.reviews.step2.tip: Tip: reviews are publicly visible on the landlord's profile. Take the time to write a constructive comment.
tutorials.reviews.step3.title: Create a property review
tutorials.reviews.step3.desc: Also rate the property itself. This information helps future tenants get a clear picture of the accommodation.
tutorials.reviews.step3.fields: Overall rating (stars) · Criteria: general condition · Listing accuracy · Insulation quality · Brightness · Neighbourhood · Free comment
tutorials.reviews.step3.tip: Tip: describe the property's strengths and areas for improvement precisely. This helps future tenants make an informed decision.
tutorials.reviews.step4.title: View reviews
tutorials.reviews.step4.desc: View the detail of an existing review: rating, criteria, comment, and date. From an application page, the Reviews tab displays a summary of all related evaluations.
tutorials.reviews.step4.fields: Review summary (Reviews tab of the application) · Review detail page · Rating per criterion · Comment · Review date · Author profile
tutorials.reviews.step4.tip: Tip: check a user's reviews before entering into a relationship with them. This is at the heart of Bailo's added value.
